title: Psalm 106:1-5 528a /
firstLine: O praise the Lord! O thank the Lord! For bountiful is He; because His loving kindness lasts to all eternity.

tuneRef.title: I'm Not Ashamed To Own My Lord

lines: O praise the Lord! O thank the Lord! For bountiful is He; because His loving kindness lasts to all eternity.
Who can express Jehovah's praise or tell His deeds of might? O blest are they who justice keep and ever do the right.
Regard me with the favor Lord, which Thou dost bear to Thine. O visit Thou my soul in love; make Thy salvation mine.
That I may see Thy people's good, and in their joy rejoice, and may with Thine inheritance exult with cheerful voice.
